name: Hau nuong trui
summary: Hàu nướng trui is oysters grilled over the fire on Đầm Lập An. The plate comes off the coals fragrant, with the boats and the stakes in view.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Báo Quốc Tế, 14 April 2026. Oyster farming on the lagoon dates from the late 1990s, in that article.
howToEat: Eat it on the lagoon, with the boats and the stakes in view.
where: Đường Nguyễn Văn, along Đầm Lập An.
seoTitle: Hau nuong trui in Lang Co — oysters over a fire
seoDescription: Hàu nướng trui is oysters grilled over the fire on Đầm Lập An, fragrant off the coals.
